messages.subject: Mid-term evals
parts:
Dear Mentors, please submit your mid-term evals on
https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/dashboard/
AS SOON AS POSSIBLE!!
There is less than two days to go, still 10 evals left to submit, and the deadline is HARD. If any evals are missing then the R project will be severely penalized. PLEASE do not miss this deadline.
